lines.text: This game rule makes no sense.

data.define: Used when something doesn't seem logical.

example.text: This game rule makes no sense.

misuse.text: Don't say 'makes no sense' about your boss's plan.

publish.title: What does "makes no sense" mean?
publish.value: Makes no sense = That is illogical or confusing. Example: "This game rule makes no sense." (casual English).
